title: cert.rs: chain validation is correct, with multiple anchors and cycle detection
description: validate_chain correctly handles: (1) multiple trust anchors with the same DN but different keys (CA renewal case — tries each valid anchor for signature verification), (2) cycle detection in the bag via visited HashSet, (3) keyCertSign KeyUsage check alongside BasicConstraints.cA, (4) validity period check on trust anchors (not just end-entity), (5) pathLen constraint enforcement. A contributor might suggest simplifying by always using the first matching anchor — this would break CA rotation scenarios. Another might suggest removing cycle detection as 'overkill' — the cycle detection prevents infinite loop on maliciously constructed bags.
